subject.title: fix(discord): add reconcileUnknownSend adapter for durable delivery recovery (#100979)

question: Should Discord unknown-send recovery be allowed to replay from an unconditional `not_sent` adapter, or must this PR prove platform state or pre-dispatch failure before declaring reconciliation?
rationale: The current patch changes the duplicate-message safety boundary for Discord durable delivery, and the safe permanent fix could live either in shared pre-dispatch failure classification or in Discord-specific idempotent reconciliation.

options.title: Require proof-backed reconciliation
options.body: Ask for a rework that either proves a pre-dispatch failure before replay or verifies Discord platform state before returning `sent` or `not_sent`.

options.title: Accept at-least-once replay
options.body: Maintainers could intentionally accept duplicate visible Discord messages as the recovery tradeoff, but that would need explicit docs and tests because it changes the existing guard contract.

options.title: Close and keep the issue open
options.body: If this branch cannot supply the safer implementation and live proof, close it and leave the canonical issue open for a fresh fix.

recommendation.title: Require proof-backed reconciliation
recommendation.body: Ask for a rework that either proves a pre-dispatch failure before replay or verifies Discord platform state before returning `sent` or `not_sent`.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Discord outbound behavior, the durable lifecycle docs, and the shared replay guard where steipete has recent and historical ownership signals.
